name: Clear temporary files
description: Deletes files older than the given number of days from the Windows temp folder and every user's temp folder. Files in use are skipped.

name: Flush DNS cache
description: Clears the DNS client cache and re-registers the computer's DNS records.

name: Refresh Group Policy
description: Re-applies computer Group Policy with gpupdate /force.

name: Restart print spooler and clear queue
description: Stops the Print Spooler, deletes stuck print jobs (unless turned off) and starts it again.

name: Restart a service
description: Restarts one Windows service by name or display name and waits until it is running.

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.label: Service name
parameters.description: Service name or display name, for example Spooler.

name: Check for a pending restart
description: Reports whether Windows is waiting for a restart and why. Exits with 1 when a restart is pending.

name: BitLocker status
description: Shows protection, encryption progress and key protectors for every volume. Exits with 1 when the system volume is unprotected.

name: Defender quick scan
description: Updates Microsoft Defender signatures, runs a quick scan and lists anything it detected.

name: Update Defender signatures
description: Downloads the latest Microsoft Defender security intelligence and reports its age.

name: Reset Windows Update components
description: Stops the update services, renames the SoftwareDistribution and catroot2 caches, resets the WinHTTP proxy and starts a fresh scan.

name: Repair system files (DISM and SFC)
description: Repairs the component store with DISM /RestoreHealth, then checks protected system files with SFC /scannow.

name: Recent error events
description: Groups critical and error events from the System and Application logs by source and event id.

name: Resynchronise the clock
description: Starts the Windows Time service if needed, forces a resync and shows the time source.

name: Kill a process by name
description: Terminates every process with the given name. Unsaved work in those processes is lost; critical system processes are refused.

name: Large file report
description: Lists the largest files under a folder (the system drive by default).

parameters.name: SearchPath
parameters.label: Folder
parameters.description: Leave empty for the system drive.

name: Free space report
description: Reports free space on every fixed drive and writes the lowest value to the device custom fields disk_free_gb and disk_free_pct when they exist and allow script writes.

name: Listening ports
description: Lists listening TCP ports and UDP endpoints with the owning process.

name: Pending Windows updates
description: Asks Windows Update for applicable updates that are not installed. Exits with 1 when updates are pending.

name: Local administrators
description: Lists the members of the local Administrators group, including domain and Entra ID entries.

name: Signed-in users
description: Shows console and remote desktop sessions with their state and idle time.

name: Disable a local account
description: Disables a local user account and signs out its sessions. Refuses the built-in Administrator and the last enabled local administrator.

name: Reset the network stack
description: Resets Winsock and TCP/IP, flushes DNS and renews DHCP leases. Connectivity drops briefly and a restart finishes the reset.

name: Restart the computer
description: Schedules a restart after a delay and shows a message to signed-in users.

name: Windows Firewall status
description: Shows each firewall profile and the inbound allow rules open to any address. Exits with 1 when a profile is off.

name: Installed software
description: Lists installed programs from the machine-wide uninstall keys, optionally filtered by name.

name: Uptime and restart history
description: Shows uptime, the last boot and the recorded reasons for recent shutdowns and crashes.

name: Package cache cleanup
description: Cleans the apt, dnf, yum, zypper, pacman or apk cache and removes packages that are no longer needed.

name: Shrink the systemd journal
description: Rotates the journal and removes old entries beyond the size and age limits.

name: Failed systemd units
description: Lists failed systemd units with their last log lines. Exits with 1 when any unit failed.

name: Pending package updates
description: Lists packages with available updates, security updates first. Exits with 1 when updates are pending.

name: Install package updates
description: Installs all available updates (or only security updates) non-interactively. Services may restart.

name: Restart a systemd service
description: Restarts a systemd unit and shows its status, or its recent log when the restart fails.

name: Flush DNS cache
description: Flushes systemd-resolved, nscd, dnsmasq or unbound, whichever is running.

name: Check and step the clock
description: Shows synchronisation status and asks chrony or systemd-timesyncd to synchronise now.

name: User accounts and admins
description: Lists accounts that can log in, members of sudo, wheel and admin, UID 0 accounts and recent logins.

name: Check for a pending restart
description: Reports whether a restart is needed for new packages or a newer kernel. Exits with 1 when one is pending.

name: Listening ports
description: Lists listening TCP ports and bound UDP sockets with the owning process (ss or lsof).

name: SSH server configuration audit
description: Checks the effective sshd configuration against common hardening settings. Exits with 1 when there are findings.

name: Free space report
description: Reports free space on local file systems and writes the lowest value to the device custom fields disk_free_gb and disk_free_pct when they exist and allow script writes.

name: Large file report
description: Lists the largest files under a directory without crossing into other file systems.

name: Kill a process by name
description: Sends TERM, then KILL after five seconds, to every process with the exact name. Unsaved work is lost.

name: Available macOS updates
description: Lists available software updates without installing anything. Exits with 1 when updates are available.

name: Gatekeeper and SIP status
description: Reports Gatekeeper, System Integrity Protection and XProtect. Exits with 1 when Gatekeeper or SIP is off.

name: FileVault status
description: Reports FileVault encryption and the users who can unlock the disk. Exits with 1 when FileVault is off.

name: macOS firewall status
description: Shows the application firewall state, stealth mode and application rules. Exits with 1 when the firewall is off.

name: Flush DNS cache
description: Flushes the directory service cache and mDNSResponder.

name: Local accounts and admins
description: Lists local user accounts and marks the administrators.

name: Resynchronise the clock
description: Switches network time on if needed and steps the clock against the configured time server.

name: Clear temporary files
description: Deletes files older than the given number of days from the shared temporary folders and user cache folders.
